profile.headline: MHCI’26 @ Carnegie Mellon University
profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Julie, a UX researcher and product strategist interested in how technology shapes human behavior, systems, and everyday experiences. My work focuses on understanding complex problems through research and translating insights into thoughtful product and design strategies.

I have experience in user research, prototyping, and usability testing, and enjoy working across disciplines where technology, policy, and design intersect. Recently, my work has explored mobility and transportation systems, examining how emerging technologies influence both users and workers within larger socio-technical environments.

Outside of work, you can often find me exploring coffee shops in new cities and drawing inspiration from the everyday environments around me!

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Conduct research with the Tech Solidarity Lab on public transit systems, focusing on scheduling practices and how technology and operational decisions impact transit workers and service reliability.

positions.title: UX Researcher (Industry Project)
positions.description: Collaborated with Blizzard as an industry partner in a  project to analyze player sentiment around World of Warcraft using Brandwatch, conducting social listening and sentiment analysis to identify community trends and inform insights about player experience.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description: Led product direction and internal operations for a five-person design studio serving small businesses. Managed client contracts for digital and physical design deliverables while improving internal workflows and service offerings to support business growth.

positions.title: Lead Designer
positions.description: Promoted to Lead Designer to help launch the Design Pit, building out a new design department and supporting digital fabrication and print projects.

positions.title: Studio Intern
positions.description:
Operated digital fabrication equipment including 3D printers using Orbium® filament, laser engravers, large-format printers, and direct-to-garment printers.
Created digital designs using Illustrator, Photoshop, and AutoCAD for print and production projects.
Produced materials such as team apparel, plaques, banners, and posters for schools and organizations.
Collaborated with a team to manage design production workflows and support client projects.
Mentored students and gained insight into the intersection of design, technology, and education.

honors.title: Korean American Day Art Contest
honors.description:
First place in the 2018 Korean American Day Art Contest
Theme: Finding the Beauty and Spirit in Korean History 

Created an artwork pertaining important women figures of Korea
